dict.string: While Settings › Accessibility › Motion › Reduce Motion is on, every icon effect (Tornado, Orbital, Warp, Holographic Layers, Circuit Flow, Magnetic Grid) uses the stock iOS animation. Page effects are unchanged.

Icon effects update a few layer properties per icon per frame and allocate no images. Frame rate and battery impact have NOT been measured on a device yet. If a page stutters, choose Magnetic Grid or a page effect.

Enable Vortex (main page) turns everything off immediately. If SpringBoard keeps crashing, Vortex disables itself after 3 quick crashes, or create the kill-switch file described in the package's Removal notes and respring.
